title: Create: Schematic Preview
description: A 3D schematic preview inside Create's Schematic Table
body:
# Create: Schematic Preview

A Create addon that adds a 3D preview of your schematics inside the Schematic Table

![In-game UI](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/96697c4df77ade582e12f903a4547d1fd65eb6b6.png)

Schematic item tooltips also support preview. Hold **Alt** while hovering a Schematic item to see it.

![tooltip-preview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5a700536d1d717242166b10a705f60a9e1aba89f.gif)
